slot_scores.name: contract_full_coverage
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether a signed contract must be kept for its entire term or whether partial usage is allowed.

slot_scores.name: contract_length_diversity
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether at least two distinct contract lengths must be used.

slot_scores.name: max_distinct_contracts
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any cap on the number of distinct contract types.

slot_scores.name: demand_exact_satisfaction
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is it acceptable for the total rented area in a given month to exceed the required area (i.e., over-renting is allowed), or must the total rented area in each month be exactly equal to the required area?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether monthly rented area must exactly match required area or whether over-renting is allowed.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is the objective to minimize the total rental cost across all warehouses and all contract types?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly confirmed the objective is to minimize total rental cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: A signed contract is used for its entire term; no partial usage or early termination is modeled.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether a contract must remain active for all months in its coverage period.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No requirement to use at least two distinct contract lengths; any combination, including a single contract type, is allowed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about contract-length diversification.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no limit on the number of distinct contract types that can be signed.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a maximum number of distinct contracts.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 contract-length diversity requirement remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several important modeling details, including exact demand satisfaction and the cost-minimization objective, but missed the P1 contract-length diversity requirement and two lower-severity hidden constraints before declaring READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
